name: Zalamerenye (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, green at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Zalamerenye (a green and blue shield with a white church, a bunch of grapes and a wavy stripe) above the name ZALAMERENYE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
